question: Sophie starts from Point A and drives 8 km towards south. She then takes a right turn, drives 6 km, turns left and drives 5 km. She then takes a left turn and drives 6 km. She takes a final right turn, drives 9 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should she drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
• Sophie starts from Point A and drives 8 km towards south.
 
• She then takes a right turn, drives 6 km, turns left and drives 5 km.
 
• She then takes a left turn and drives 6 km.
 
• She takes a final right turn, drives 9 km and stops at Point P.
